The product stores its 19-family error from the joint replicas, which the family cells do not carry. The standard trigger (the loosened menu) and the floor have one unit each: no spread. The rate-neutral standard is not stored per family.
R3.budget: Unique background rate of the novelty trigger, in percent of the recorded Level-1 accept rate
